actions.intent: Remove the fingers from the handle and clear the front for actual closure verification.

visible_evidence: The current wrist RGB shows the windowed door beside the control panel with the yellow mug visible behind its window. The last push stopped against this configuration; convergence failure alone does not establish closure. Withdraw the hand without further pushing so the door seam and mug can be checked unobstructed.
